card.name: Verbs of researching or figuring out
card.fires_on: Verbs and particles describing scientists or researchers working to find out, study or solve something, such as researching, understand, figure out, looking for, investigate, discover. It fires just before the thing being sought.

modes.label: Scientists seeking answers
modes.description: Research verbs after phrases like still looking or yet to, before the unknown cause or solution.
modes.example: scientists are yet to<< understand>> why the disorder occurs.

modes.label: Research or study activities
modes.description: Verbs naming study, investigation or development work in lists or lesson text.
modes.example: • <<researching>> and designing new drugs to help cure cancer

modes.label: Modeling or planning work
modes.description: Verbs or linking words in descriptions of what scientists or physicians do to work out a model or plan.
modes.example: developing a mathematical model<< of>> a biological or chemical system

card.writes: It seems to push toward words for ways, approaches and possible solutions to a problem.
card.plain: It lights up on words about scientists trying to find out or work out something not yet known.
evidence: scientists are yet to<< understand>> why the disorder occurs
researchers are still looking<< for>> solutions to the problem
They hope to better understand the condition and<< discover>> an effective treatment.
